title: GET /api/data/facets
description: Facet taxonomy + dataset totals.  Drives the rail filters (#n-country, #n-body etc.), the year slider min/max, and is the canonical source for dataset record count.  Frontend caches this for ~24h.

countries.description: Includes the 198+ canonical UN states plus a small set of dirty entries (2-letter ISO leaks like AU/CO/CZ); the frontend filters via cleanCountryList.

bodies.description: All recommending bodies; classified into UPR / Treaty Bodies / Special Procedures families client-side.

regions.description: Treaty Body / HRC electoral groups taxonomy ('Eastern Europe', 'Western Europe & Others', etc.). The hex map and overview use a separate M49 taxonomy resolved client-side.

total_records.description: Cleaned-pipeline total. Should be ~267k as of 2026-04.
